## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Performance → **Pricing Review** (`/vendor-scores/pricing-review`)

The **Pricing Review Queue** lets admins verify vendor pricing against market rates. Each verification records the correct market price for a device in a given condition, building training data for the AI pricing engine.

## What the screen shows

### KPI cards

| Card | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Pending Review** | Orders waiting for verification. |
| **Verified** | Orders already verified. |
| **Avg Accuracy** | Average pricing accuracy of verified orders. |
| **Today** | Verifications done today. |
| **Verification Rate** | Share of orders that have been verified. |

### Queue table

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Order | Short order ID and city. |
| Device | Category (Mobile, Tablet, Console…) and model. |
| Vendor | Vendor who completed the order. |
| Generated | Price quoted to the customer when the order was created. |
| Final | Final price paid after inspection. |
| Dip | % change from generated to final (negative = price dropped). Colour-coded by size. |
| Action | **Review**. |

Paginated at 20 per page with a total pending count.

## Verify a price

Click **Review** to open **Verify Pricing — &lt;device&gt;**:

| Section | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Price Timeline | Generated → Requote → Final price. |
| Device Condition | Body, screen, physical and technical condition codes, warranty status, whether the device turns on, and accessories. |
| Inspection Photos | Device side photos and the vendor's selfie from the pickup. |
| **What should the correct market price be?** | Enter the verified market price. |
| **Notes** (optional) | Any observations about pricing. |

Click **Verify Price** to save, or **Cancel** to close.

<Callout kind="tip">
Large dips between Generated and Final are the most useful to review: they show either a quote that was too high or a vendor deducting too much at inspection. Vendors with consistently large dips also show a low **Pricing Accuracy** / **Requote Behavior** score on the Leaderboard.
</Callout>
